outputs.clause_text: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other party.

Vendor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Customer from and against any and all claims, damages, losses, and expenses, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising out of or resulting from Vendor's breach of this Agreement, without any cap or limitation on liability.
During the term of this Agreement and for a period of five (5) years thereafter, Contractor shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in any business that competes with Company anywhere in the world.
In no event shall either party's aggregate liability under this Agreement exceed the total fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

All work product, inventions, and intellectual property created by Contractor in connection with the Services shall be the sole and exclusive property of Company, and Contractor hereby assigns all right, title, and interest therein to Company.
This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term.
